refusalReason: part of the playing field is outside the frame, so the regions that fall off the edge cannot be measured at all
title: Deliberately unreadable — half the board out of the picture
instructions: This one is meant to fail, and it is the most valuable shot in the session: it is how the corpus checks that Buddy says "I cannot read this" instead of guessing.
Set the board back to the STARTING position.
Move the phone in close, or off to the side, until roughly a third of the playing field is outside the picture — one bear-off tray and the points beside it should be missing entirely.
Take the photo. This is the LAST shot of the session — the phone may be moved freely afterwards.
